topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I found the hidden room today, tucked away behind the old bookshelf. It's small, barely enough space to stand, with dusty air and a floor of dirt. I should be thrilled, uncovering a secret like this, but I can't shake a sense of unease. The walls are lined with faded photographs and cryptic notes, each one sending a chill. I didn't expect to find company in this solitude, yet here it is, staring back at me. I've locked the bookshelf back in place, concealing it once more. Maybe it's better hidden; some secrets are better left undisturbed.
